dct_description_sm:
[revise] 

This study is an in-campaign poll of the 2022 Ontario General Election. The poll was conducted between April 13-14, 2022. A sample of 1001 Ontarians aged 18+ was interviewed online, via the Ipsos I-Say panel and non-panel sources, and respondents earned a nominal incentive for their participation. Weighting was employed to ensure the sample’s composition reflected the adult population according to 2016 Census data. Respondents provided information on government and party preferences, voting intentions, party leadership, and issues determining how they will vote.
